subject: System Design
title: Horizontal Scaling with Auto-Scaling
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Horizontal Scaling with Auto-Scaling.

hook.text: Black Friday traffic spikes 10x. Your servers auto-scale from 5 to 50 in minutes, then scale back down.

buildup.text: Auto-scaling monitors CPU, memory, or request count and adds or removes servers automatically.

discovery.text: Cloud providers like AWS and GCP offer auto-scaling groups that react to traffic in real time.

twist.text: Scaling up takes minutes. If traffic spikes faster than new servers boot, users experience errors.

climax.text: Auto-scaling handles predictable growth. Unpredictable spikes need pre-warming or over-provisioning.

punchline.text: Auto-scale for the expected; pre-warm for the spike.

quiz.question: What triggers auto-scaling?
options: Metrics like CPU usage, memory, or request count
